morphology.pattern_note: root_word 与 root_jawi 按输入保留，但输入将整个派生词误判为词根；实际词根是 bongkar，DBP 词根 Jawi 为 بوڠکر。ter- 接 b 时不改变词根声母，表示动作造成的状态或事情被揭开的结果；意外性须由语境判断。参见 [DBP PRPM：bongkar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=bongkar)。

senses.zh_definition: 已被拆开、拆散或强行打开，处于原有结构或封闭状态遭到破坏的状态。
senses.en_definition: To have been dismantled, taken apart or forced open.
senses.nuances: 这里采用物理义；具体是拆解、撬开还是翻开，由主语和上下文决定。该词不表示主动拆解某物的人。参见 [DBP PRPM：terbongkar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=terbongkar)。

collocations.en: the floor has been torn up
the safe has been forced open

senses.zh_definition: 秘密、阴谋或隐瞒的行为被揭露、曝光；真相显露。
senses.en_definition: To be exposed or brought to light, especially of a secret, plot or concealed wrongdoing.
senses.ms_definition: Telah diketahui atau terdedah perkara yang sebelumnya dirahsiakan atau disembunyikan.
senses.nuances: 此处展开 DBP 的“已被揭开”义，常以 rahsia、penipuan 或 komplot 作主语。ter- 强调曝光结果，并不保证是无意泄露。依据 [DBP PRPM：bongkar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=bongkar) 及其 [英马词典对应例](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=membongkar)。

dual_scenarios.ms: Penipuan itu terbongkar selepas pasukan audit meneliti rekod pembayaran syarikat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 审计小组检查公司付款记录后，骗局被揭穿了。
dual_scenarios.en: The fraud came to light after the audit team examined the company's payment records.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友商量惊喜聚会
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Rahsia kita dah terbongkar lah; dia dah nampak kek tu.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Rahsia kita sudah terbongkar kerana dia sudah melihat kek itu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 咱们的秘密露馅啦，他已经看到那个蛋糕了。
dual_scenarios.en: Our secret's out. He's already seen the cake.
spoken_features: dah 对应 sudah，标示事情已经发生。
句末 lah 带出无奈或感叹语气。
tu 对应 itu，是常见口语缩略。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Rahsia kita dah terbongkar lah. Amir nampak kek tu kat dapur tadi.
messages.ms_standard: Rahsia kita sudah terbongkar. Amir melihat kek itu di dapur tadi.
messages.zh: 咱们的秘密露馅啦，阿米尔刚才在厨房看到蛋糕了。
messages.en: Our secret's out. Amir saw the cake in the kitchen earlier.

messages.speaker: Hana (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Tak apa lah, dia belum tahu siapa yang nak datang. Kita teruskan je.
messages.ms_standard: Tidak mengapa. Dia belum mengetahui siapa yang akan datang. Kita teruskan sahaja rancangan itu.
messages.zh: 没事啦，他还不知道谁会来，咱们照原计划办就行。
messages.en: It's fine. He still doesn't know who's coming. Let's go ahead with it.

etymology.historical_story: Terbongkar is formed transparently from ter- and bongkar. The dictionary places physical opening, dismantling and revealing secrets within the same word family. A useful conceptual bridge is a closed container: opening it exposes its contents, just as uncovering concealed information makes a secret known. This explains the metaphor without establishing its historical chronology. Source: [DBP PRPM: bongkar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=bongkar).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bongkar 想成“拆开盖子”，再加 ter- 看结果：盖子被打开，秘密也就 terbongkar——曝光了。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 用于报告曝光结果时语体中性；当面对别人说 rahsia awak terbongkar 可能带揭短、指责或威胁意味。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合描述调查发现或秘密揭晓。新闻和职场汇报应区分已查明的事实与尚待证实的指控；朋友间也可轻松描述惊喜计划露馅。
